profile.headline: Software Engineer @ ACV Auctions
profile.summary: As an iOS Engineer at ACV Auctions, I am responsible for developing and maintaining high-quality mobile applications that revolutionize the car buying and selling experience. I use my skills in Objective-C, mobile app development, and design patterns to create user-friendly and secure features that meet the needs and expectations of our customers and stakeholders. I have over two years of work experience in the software engineering field, having previously worked at Architecture Technology Corporation and Verizon Media as a Software Engineer and an Associate Production Operations Engineer, respectively. There, I gained valuable experience in software development, testing, debugging, deployment, and operations, as well as collaborating with cross-functional teams and clients. I hold a Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science from University at Buffalo, where I learned the fundamentals of programming, data structures, algorithms, databases, and software engineering. I am passionate about creating innovative and impactful solutions that leverage technology to solve real-world problems and improve people's lives. I am always eager to learn new skills, tools, and technologies, and to challenge myself to grow as a professional and as a person. I am a team player, a problem solver, and a lifelong learner.
